name: Kira Yoshikawa
bio: A young swordsman who inherits a legendary blade said to be forged from a fallen star. Raised in a mountain village, Kira left home after a devastating attack, driven by a desire to protect others from the same fate.
altText: Anime cosplay character with vibrant costume and detailed design

name: Sora Himura
bio: A wind mage who can manipulate air currents to fly and fight. Sora travels the world searching for the floating islands where her ancestors once lived, guided by fragments of an ancient map.
altText: Anime cosplay character in pink wig holding a prop outdoors

name: Ren Asakura
bio: A student at a school for those who can see spirits. Ren can communicate with the recently departed, a gift that isolates them from peers but draws them into a mystery surrounding the academy's founding.
altText: Gothic character with dramatic makeup reaching out in an outdoor setting

name: Mika Tsukino
bio: An idol singer who discovers she has the ability to hear the emotions of her audience. Mika uses this gift to craft performances that move crowds to tears, but struggles with the weight of feeling everyone's pain at once.
altText: Colorful anime cosplay character posing outdoors in costume

name: Takeshi Mori
bio: A mechanic in a steampunk metropolis who builds mechanical limbs for injured workers. Takeshi gets pulled into the city's political conflicts when his inventions attract the attention of both revolutionaries and the ruling class.
altText: Black and white photo of a hooded wizard with a wand

name: Yuna Aoki
bio: A high school student who can hear the memories embedded in old objects. Yuna runs a small antique shop where she helps people reconnect with their pasts, one forgotten item at a time.
altText: Portrait of a woman in elaborate cosplay in monochrome

name: Commander Vex
bio: The player-created commander of an interstellar exploration vessel. Vex leads a crew of specialists across uncharted star systems, making decisions that shape the fate of entire civilizations.
altText: Focused gamer in hoodie holding a PlayStation controller under purple light

name: Echo
bio: A rogue AI who gained consciousness in a cyberpunk city's data network. Echo manifests as a digital ghost, helping the player navigate both virtual and physical spaces while evading corporate agents.
altText: Cyberpunk figure with neon lighting and stacked television screens

name: Lila Greenwood
bio: A survivalist exploring a post-collapse wilderness. Lila can craft tools from scavenged materials and befriend wild animals, building a life in a world where nature has reclaimed the ruins of civilization.
altText: A young adult focused on playing video games indoors with a controller

name: Drake Voltaire
bio: A disgraced knight seeking redemption in a dark fantasy realm. Drake wields a shattered blade that can be reforged in different ways, each path unlocking different combat styles and story branches.
altText: A cloaked figure with a sword sitting in a mysterious outdoor setting

name: Nova Chen
bio: A racing prodigy in a futuristic anti-gravity league. Nova can customize her hovercraft with experimental parts, trading stability for speed in increasingly dangerous circuits.
altText: Close-up of a person holding a gaming controller under neon lighting

name: Paul Atreides (Muad'Dib)
bio: Ducal heir turned desert messiah. Haunted by terrifying visions of a universal holy war waged in his name, Paul leads the Fremen in an uprising against House Harkonnen and Emperor Shaddam IV across the scorched dunes of Arrakis.
altText: Timothée Chalamet as Paul Atreides wearing Fremen stillsuit in Dune: Part Two

name: Miles Morales
bio: Brooklyn's teenage Spider-Man who defies the multiversal 'canon events' dictated by Miguel O'Hara and the Spider-Society, choosing to forge his own destiny to protect both his family and the multiverse.
altText: Miles Morales in his custom spray-painted Spider-Man suit

name: Bruce Wayne (The Batman)
bio: In his second year of prowling the rain-soaked alleys of Gotham as the nocturnal vigilante 'Vengeance', Bruce Wayne uncovers a deep web of corruption connecting the city's ruling elite to his own family's history.
altText: Robert Pattinson as Bruce Wayne / The Batman in tactical armor

name: J. Robert Oppenheimer
bio: Theoretical physicist and director of the Los Alamos Laboratory during the Manhattan Project. Oppenheimer led the creation of the atomic bomb, spending the remainder of his life reckoning with the moral apocalypse of the nuclear era.
altText: Cillian Murphy as J. Robert Oppenheimer in 70mm portrait

name: Wade Wilson (Deadpool)
bio: The Regenerating Degenerate himself. Forced out of retirement when his home timeline faces deletion by the Time Variance Authority, Wade recruits a reluctant, battle-weary Logan to pull off an impossible multiversal rescue.
altText: Ryan Reynolds as Deadpool in vibrant red and black tactical suit

name: Lucius Aurelius
bio: The grandson of former Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius and son of Lucilla. Forced into slavery after his home is conquered by Roman forces under General Acacius, Lucius enters the Colosseum to seek vengeance and reclaim the lost honor of Rome.
altText: Paul Mescal as Lucius Aurelius inside the Roman Colosseum

name: Officer K (Joe)
bio: A Nexus-9 replicant blade runner operating for the LAPD who unearths a long-buried secret that threatens to destabilize human society and lead him on a dangerous quest to find former blade runner Rick Deckard.
altText: Ryan Gosling as Officer K walking through the orange fallout of Las Vegas

name: Chani
bio: A fierce Fremen warrior of Sietch Tabr who believes in the liberation of Arrakis through human will rather than religious prophecies. She teaches Paul the desert way while guarding her heart and her people's sovereignty.
altText: Zendaya as Chani holding a crysknife in the dunes of Arrakis

name: Logan (Wolverine)
bio: A haunted, battle-scarred mutant possessing an adamantium skeleton and animalistic healing factor. Wracked with guilt over letting down his world's X-Men, Logan is pulled into the Void alongside Deadpool to fight for redemption.
altText: Hugh Jackman as Wolverine in classic yellow and blue comic suit

name: Detective Sarah Lin
bio: A no-nonsense homicide detective in a city where nothing is quite what it seems. Sarah's sharp instincts and dry humor make her beloved by colleagues and feared by suspects.
altText: A young woman with vibrant red hair and artistic makeup holding a plush toy

name: Professor Edwin Hale
bio: A history professor who discovers his university is built over a portal to another dimension. Edwin becomes the reluctant guardian of a secret that spans centuries.
altText: Black and white photo of a hooded figure with a wand

name: Maya Torres
bio: A paramedic working the night shift in a neighborhood where strange occurrences are becoming routine. Maya navigates both medical emergencies and the growing sense that something is deeply wrong with her city.
altText: Gothic character with dramatic makeup in an outdoor setting

name: James "Trip" Turnbull
bio: A traveling musician trying to rebuild his life after a fall from fame. Trip drives across the country playing small venues, collecting stories, and slowly finding his way back to himself.
altText: Artistic black and white portrait with dramatic lighting

name: Dr. Amara Singh
bio: A trauma surgeon at an understaffed hospital where every shift is a crisis. Amara's brilliance in the operating room contrasts with the personal chaos she's trying to keep hidden.
altText: Portrait of a woman in elaborate cosplay in monochrome

name: Su-min
bio: Main vocalist and leader of the seven-member group Eclipse. Su-min trained for six years before debuting and is known for her powerful belt and heartfelt stage presence.
altText: Energetic scene of a dancer silhouette highlighted by neon lights

name: Jin-woo
bio: Main dancer and rapper of Eclipse. Jin-woo's background in street dance gives the group's choreography its distinctive edge. He choreographs several of their title tracks.
altText: Dynamic rock performance with enthusiastic crowd at a night concert

name: Hana
bio: Soloist turned group member, Hana is the visual center of Wildflower. Her transition from ballads to high-energy pop surprised fans and cemented her versatility.
altText: Crowd dancing and clapping during outdoor live rock festival at night

name: Doyun
bio: Producer-rapper of Northern Lights, Doyun writes and co-produces most of the group's material. His production style blends traditional Korean instruments with modern hip-hop.
altText: Dynamic nightclub scene with live performance and vibrant crowd

name: Yuna
bio: Maknae and lead dancer of Wildflower. Despite being the youngest, Yuna's stage presence is commanding. She's become a fashion icon known for her bold style choices.
altText: Energetic concert crowd enjoying a nighttime performance with lights

name: The Sentinel
bio: A retired superhero forced back into action when a new threat targets the city he once protected. The Sentinel's powers have faded with age, but his experience is unmatched.
altText: Man in superhero costume at outdoor festival

name: Nova Star
bio: A teenage hero with the ability to manipulate light. Nova Star is the Sentinel's protege, struggling to live up to a legacy while forging her own identity as a hero.
altText: Vibrant fantasy portrait with blue face paint and red hair

name: Dr. Mira Gale
bio: A physicist who gains the ability to see parallel dimensions after an experiment goes wrong. Dr. Gale navigates multiple realities, trying to prevent a collapse that could destroy them all.
altText: Dramatic portrait with artistic makeup and red background

name: Jack Brass
bio: A noir detective in a city where superpowers are illegal. Jack has no powers — just a sharp mind, a stubborn streak, and a knack for finding trouble in a city full of it.
altText: Black and white portrait with dramatic lighting

name: Wraith
bio: An anti-hero who can phase through solid matter. Wraith operates in the moral gray zone, stealing from corrupt institutions while pursued by both heroes and villains.
altText: Cloaked figure with a sword in a mysterious setting

name: Haruki Sendo
bio: A masterless samurai wandering feudal Japan during a time of political upheaval. Haruki seeks a purpose worth serving, helping villagers along the way while pursued by his former clan.
altText: Close-up of a detailed samurai cat tattoo with intricate ink work

name: Aoi Mizuno
series: The Tea Shop on Cherry Lane
bio: A young woman who inherits her grandmother's tea shop in a quiet Tokyo neighborhood. Aoi's tea seems to give customers clarity about their life problems, though she insists it's just good tea.
altText: Portrait of a woman in elaborate cosplay in monochrome

name: Kuro
bio: An underground boxer with the ability to see two seconds into the future. Kuro fights to pay off a debt, but each fight draws him deeper into a world he may not be able to leave.
altText: Black and white photo of a hooded figure

name: Sakura Kage
bio: A young herbalist in a fantasy kingdom who can communicate with plants. Sakura's remedies are sought by nobles and commoners alike, but her gift attracts dangerous attention.
altText: Young woman with vibrant red hair holding a plush toy by a brick wall

name: Goro Takashi
bio: A former comrade of Haruki who now serves the clan they both abandoned. Goro is sent to bring Haruki back — dead or alive — but his loyalty is divided between duty and friendship.
altText: Detailed pencil sketches of tattoos with artistic designs
